canada.title: City of Mississauga to implement hiring restrictions effective immediately
canada.summary: One week into the term of Mississauga's new mayor and hiring restrictions are going into effect at the city. It comes after staff were directed by Mayor Alvin Tedjo to freeze property taxes for the 2027 and 2028 budgets.

canada.title: Police probing city hall corruption filed ‘inaccurate' info, says former mayor now asking for unsealed docs

canada.title: Spike in emissions a major setback in GTA climate goals: report
canada.summary: A more polluting energy grid and rising demand for gas heating during a colder winter drove the largest annual spike in planet-warming emissions in at least a decade across the Greater Toronto and Hamilton Area, a new report found, putting the region further off track of its climate goals.

canada.title: Top civil servant in N.L. fisheries department also travelled on aquaculture company’s dime
canada.summary: Newfoundland and Labrador’s fisheries minister wasn’t the only representative from the provincial government to take part in a study trip in Scotland paid entirely by the aquaculture giant MOWI. His department's top civil servant, Keith Sullivan, also tagged along.

canada.title: PAL and flight attendants reach tentative agreement, still needs to be ratified
canada.summary: PAL Airlines and CUPE, which represents some 150 flight attendants, have reached a tentative agreement but it will still need to be ratified. The airline is still in negotiations with its pilots, who are represented by the Air Line Pilots Association.

canada.title: Yukon Energy fires contractor building grid-scale battery, cites project delays

canada.title: Emissions are another reason for an environmental review of EverWind’s hyperscale data centre

canada.title: After 15 years and 2 fires, Beauval, Sask., receives funding for new community complex
